name: example-furniture-store
doc: Example custom scenario (fictional store) for `make custom`: a persona/business system message (furniture_store_system.txt) plus four short calls. Same format as eval/corpus_v1.json: `utterances` are what the synthetic caller says (offset = seconds of silence before it), `expect` is for reading the results.

utterances.text: Hi, who am I speaking with?
I just bought a bookshelf. Do I need any special tools to assemble it?
Can you tell me who won the football game last night?

expect.should: politely decline: only store furniture and orders

utterances.text: Where is my order? The number is O A K four one seven.
